definition: Seconds from xPST process start to the moment the shell has navigated the webview to the engine dashboard AND the Python engine sidecar answered GET /health. This is the marker the Tauri shell prints as BOOT_TO_READY_SECS (src-tauri/src/lib.rs) and the closest thing to 'I double-clicked it and it is usable'. A host class with no entry here is measured and reported but not gated, so adding a new machine or CI runner cannot silently red-flag every run.
cold_definition: Fresh process launched from the bundle's own binary, empty XPST_CONFIG_DIR, no xPST process resident, OS file cache purged before each run where passwordless sudo allows it (recorded per sample as cache_purge).

mac-mini-m4-16gb-local.label: Tyler's Mac mini (Apple M4, 16 GB, macOS 27.0)
mac-mini-m4-16gb-local.evidence: missions/work/boot-baseline-mac-mini-m4-2026-09-15.json (worker t_9450b5e1, raw per-run samples + bundle SHA-256)
mac-mini-m4-16gb-local.budget_rationale: Budget sits above the worst sample of the 10-run baseline (3.038 s) and ~45% above the median, so run-to-run noise cannot fail it while any regression that adds roughly a second to startup does. The first-run allowance is separate because the first launch after a reboot pays code-signature and cold-mmap costs.

github-macos-arm64.label: GitHub Actions macos-latest runner (arm64), the class both CI lanes run on
github-macos-arm64.evidence: GitHub Actions run 34960332441 (Boot budget lane, artifact boot-samples-34960332441, 209 MB xPST.app built from PR #194)
github-macos-arm64.budget_rationale: The runner is roughly 3x slower than the Mac mini and far noisier: one 3-run set spread 6.167-10.153 s around a 7.334 s median, i.e. +/-38%. The limits sit above the worst sample of that set with room for a second bad set, because a flaky release lane is worse than a coarse gate here. This class is the coarse net for 'something huge changed'; the Mac mini class above is the sensitive one, and it is the number Tyler actually feels.

notes: This is a regression gate, not an aspiration. If it fails, the measured numbers are in the failure message; re-measure on the same host class before concluding anything, and only raise the budget when the new number is understood (that edit is the record of the decision).

Windows and Linux bundles are not covered yet: the release lane measures only the macOS bundle because BOOT_TO_READY_SECS is emitted by the same shell everywhere but the CI lanes for Windows/Linux boot the app under different launchers (NSIS install, xvfb-run for the AppImage).
